verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Paxos offering a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec, and the probe found no spec at any common OpenAPI or Swagger path (all returned 404). The llms.txt and llms-full.txt files are AI-indexing documentation dumps, and the markdown API reference pages are human-oriented docs; neither is a machine-readable API specification, so they are adjacent features only and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
